headline: Third US Carrier Rushes to Region as Iran Fires Ballistic Missiles
subheadline: Iran launched two ballistic missiles from Kurdistan Province as Israel killed Hamas's Rafah Brigade commander and demolished a Hezbollah tunnel.
lede: Russia launched a massive overnight barrage of Shahed-type drones, reactive drones, Geran-5 missiles, and Banderoil cruise missiles targeting energy infrastructure across 15+ Ukrainian regions, striking substations near Kyiv and in Kitsman and hitting the Kremenchuk oil refinery. Ukraine retaliated with a drone strike on Russia's Akhtubinsk airfield in Astrakhan region, causing over 30 explosions. Meanwhile, Iran launched two ballistic missiles from Qorveh, Kurdistan Province, as Israel killed Hamas's Rafah Brigade commander in Khan Younis and demolished a 35-meter Hezbollah tunnel in southern Lebanon. The USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier group is en route to join two other US carriers in the region.

sections.title: Russia Pounds Energy Grid; Ukraine Strikes Deep
sections.body: Russia attacked Ukraine with Shahed-type drones, reactive drones, Geran-5 missiles, and Banderoil cruise missiles launched from Primorsko-Akhtarsk and Gvardeyskoye across 15+ regions overnight 15-16 November. Geran-5 missiles hit a substation near Kyiv, a substation in Kitsman, Chernivtsi region, and the Kremenchuk oil refinery, while Banderoil missiles struck Poltava and Kremenchuk. Ukrainian drones struck Akhtubinsk airfield in Russia's Astrakhan region, causing over 30 explosions that damaged infrastructure, aircraft parking, and ammunition depots. The EU also boarded and detained Russian shadow fleet tanker MV MIDAG in the Mediterranean, confirming a false Zimbabwe flag and origin from Kozmino port.

sections.title: Iran Fires Missiles; Third US Carrier Deploys
sections.body: Iran launched two ballistic missiles from Qorveh, Kurdistan Province, while three strong explosions hit Jurf Al Sakhar, Babil Province, Iraq, with cause unclear. Israel killed Hamas's Rafah Brigade commander in a Khan Younis airstrike and demolished a 35-meter Hezbollah tunnel in Majdal Zoun, southern Lebanon, using Yahalom combat engineers. A daily Lebanese report documented 112 Israeli attack alerts including airstrikes on Qantara and Kfar Tibnit and artillery shelling across 10 locations. The USS Theodore Roosevelt carrier group is en route to join two other US carriers in the region.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Russia's simultaneous use of Geran-5 missiles, Banderoil cruise missiles, and reactive drone swarms from multiple launch sites indicates sophisticated coordination and sustained capacity for nationwide strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure, while Ukraine's Akhtubinsk strike signals growing long-range reach. Iran's ballistic missile launches from Kurdistan Province and UAV activity over the Iraqi border demonstrate expanded kinetic reach, with simultaneous explosions in Jurf Al Sakhar, Al-Musayyib, and Hormozgan Province suggesting either Israeli sabotage or internal Iranian air defense engagements. The arrival of a third US carrier strike group significantly alters the maritime balance and may deter Iranian retaliation while enabling broader strike options.
